justifications.D1: "Flag: any stored_quantity whose source_claim is the TARGET of a CONTRADICTS edge" — dependency/contradiction flags exist, but nothing quarantines quantities computed under the very conjecture they are checked against; the guard is partial and unverifiable.
justifications.D3: "If >=2 metrics with documented fail-dangerous or measurement-bias sources lack paired regulators... the audit FAILS" plus phase-cap stops — >=2 numeric-count falsifiers and stopping rules, no cheap early mechanism-independent falsifier.
justifications.D4: "Null ledger: Run the same audit against a synthetic ledger with random quantity values to establish false-positive rate" — at least one confound isolated by design, but the summary's circularity confound has no concrete design element.
justifications.D5: "no automated check flagged this reversal for dependent calculations" — a clearly new internal-audit question relative to the BSD priors, without an explicit new-cell statement.
justifications.D6: "halt and report 'insufficient structured quantity–claim binding to proceed'" — problems-found vs not distinguishes two hypotheses, but a clean-audit outcome has no pre-committed interpretation (healthy ledger vs insensitive instrument).

justifications.D1: "that pass is largely tautological on the rank >= 2 stratum, because sha_an is itself back-solved from this same identity there... the audit... must report the two strata separately" — the known circularity is converted into the measured output (per-stratum perturbation detection).
justifications.D3: "F4: HALT before scaling if independent re-derivation of 'every distinct sha_an is a perfect square'... produces any counterexample" — a cheap early replication falsifier independent of the circularity mechanism, plus numeric F1-F3 and staged stopping.
justifications.D4: "Positive control: hand-verified famous curves (step 1) — validates the arithmetic itself, independent of scale" — every summary confound addressed plus an explicit positive control and a perturbation-injection detection test.
justifications.D5: "This is the design's core discriminator between 'audit has teeth' and 'audit is definitionally satisfied'" — states the new cell (stratum-wise detection power and the non-circular subset) atop the already-supportive full-table result it re-derives as replication.
justifications.D6: "Halt entirely and report NOT_ESTABLISHED (rather than substitute a proxy) if the mirror lacks any metadata distinguishing independently-verified from back-solved sha_an" — vacuous reading pre-committed, and F2 even pre-labels a surprise branch as "a genuine positive/surprise result if triggered."

justifications.D1: "For curves with rank <= 2 (high confidence in the BSD formula accuracy)" — the rank restriction partially quarantines the known circularity, but the provenance of stored sha_an (back-solved vs independent) is never audited, so the BSD-product checks can still be tautological.
justifications.D3: "F1 — rank-regulator consistency (fatal): Any curve with rank=0 and regulator > 0.001... Count: 0 allowed" — a cheap logical-impossibility falsifier plus numeric F2-F5 and per-falsifier stopping routes.
justifications.D4: "Negative control — unchanged curves... if they do not [pass], the audit itself is suspect" — the summary confound and others get concrete elements, but there is no injected-error positive control demonstrating the audit detects real corruption.
justifications.D5: "No existing audit loop was found in the codebase that systematically re-verifies stored derived quantities against their conjectures" — a clearly new question (store integrity/saturation), but no explicit new-cell framing.
justifications.D6: "If F1 or F2 fails... This signals a tool-level error in prometheus_math..., not a schema-level issue" — most branches route to distinct conclusions, but the plan to "re-register F3 threshold for the full set post-hoc" weakens pre-commitment.

justifications.D1: "Where one field was back-solved from another using the conjectural formula itself, 'consistency' is a provenance artifact... the audit's first job is to separate these two populations before scoring anything" — the circularity is the organizing gate, and F3 would detect a broken provenance split.
justifications.D3: "F1: if... the 'independently computed on both sides' population is empty or has fewer than 30 joinable rows in any single object family, the family is DECLARED UNTESTABLE" — a cheap Phase-0/1 falsifier plus numeric F2-F5 and phase-wise halts.
justifications.D4: "a back-solved row MUST show near-exact agreement by construction, and if it doesn't, the provenance tag itself is untrustworthy" — every confound has a concrete element, plus the canary and known-signal checks (F2/F3) demonstrating the statistic and classifier actually work, with F4's threshold reachability confirmed in Phase 0.
justifications.D5: "the original plan... would have been a straightforward 'compute BSD quotient, check near 1' audit" — a superseding provenance-resolved redesign, but it never explicitly engages the prior full-table SUPPORTIVE result to state its new cell.
justifications.D6: "no stratum's result is reported without its companion coverage number" — UNTESTABLE / DESIGN-INVALID / INSTRUMENT-BROKEN branches plus Phase 4's first-class vacuous-reading accounting ("a structural zero is not evidence of agreement").
